newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony shares decline on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Sony shares decline on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares of electronic giant Sony Corp slipped on Monday as profit-taking intensified after the shares hit a record high on Friday, boosted by robust sales growth for the first quarter, traders said.
At 0424 GMT, Sony's shares were down 500 yen at 11,700 on trading volume of about one million shares.
The share price surged to an all-time high of 12,600 yen on Friday, cheered by Sony's good results released late on Thursday.
"There are growing expectations that the shares will consolidate for a while below the high (of 12,600 yen) marked on August 1," said a trader at a foreign securities house.
"Foreign investors in particular were selling the shares to take profits."
